briefing_zh:
今天最清晰的主线是：agent 能力正在从「更大的模型」迁移到「更好的 runtime 与 harness」。**AI4AI at Test-Time** 证明强模型可以在不更新弱模型参数的前提下，为其构建推理时 harness；**Spark-to-Paper** 则把完整科研流程拆成十三个可组合、可执行、可校验的 skills。两者共同说明，系统层的任务分解、工具接口和 verification 已经成为可迁移的能力载体，而不只是模型外面的工程包装。

第二条主线是长程 agent 的安全与一致性开始被当作一等研究对象。**OpenART** 用可持续改变状态的环境扩展 red teaming，**NCP-Bench** 检查 agent 在用户不断干预时能否守住长期叙事承诺，**AutoWorldModel-Bench** 则把自主研究本身变成闭环 benchmark。alphaxiv 上的 **Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs** 和 **Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing?** 进一步把风险从单次回答推进到系统边界：前者指向 provider 内部 reasoning 隔离，后者揭示缺少 rationale 的持久指令会产生「catastrophic remembering」。

模型与 world model 方向也出现了两种互补的压缩。**BDH-CQ** 用 recurrent latent state 替代大量显式 CoT token，以 150M 参数展示低成本迭代推理；**JEPA-WAM** 则把未来转移建模放进 joint-embedding space，避免直接生成视频的开销。与此同时，**Muse Glimmer** 把 30B agentic model 压进 24–32 GB 本地设备，而 **Needle 2** 更激进地把专用 tool-calling model 压到 14 MB，说明「本地 agent」正在分化为通用 personal agent 与极窄、极可靠的 edge controller 两条路线。

开源生态今天关注的不是又一个聊天 UI，而是 agent 的执行边界和协作基础设施：**phone-harness** 用 iPhone Mirroring 建立真实手机控制通道，**moli** 以按需渲染降低 browser agent 成本，**KADATH** 用可度量 benchmark 进化多 agent population，**Docker Sandboxes** 则把无人值守 coding agent 放进 disposable microVM。反面信号同样强烈：Gentoo Bugzilla 因分布式 LLM scraper 流量被迫下线，说明 agent 扩张的外部性已经从安全担忧变成公共基础设施的现实成本。
briefing_en:
The clearest theme today is that agent capability is moving from simply scaling models toward improving runtimes and harnesses. **AI4AI at Test-Time** shows that a stronger model can build an inference-time harness that transfers capability to a weaker target without changing its weights, while **Spark-to-Paper** decomposes end-to-end research into thirteen composable, executable, and verifiable skills. Together they argue that task decomposition, tool interfaces, and verification are becoming portable capability substrates rather than mere engineering around a model.

Long-horizon safety and consistency are also becoming first-class research targets. **OpenART** scales red teaming through persistent, state-changing environments; **NCP-Bench** asks whether agents preserve narrative commitments under unconstrained user interventions; and **AutoWorldModel-Bench** turns autonomous research into a closed-loop benchmark. On alphaXiv, **Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs** and **Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing?** push the risk boundary from individual outputs to system architecture: provider-internal reasoning isolation can fail, and persistent instructions without recorded rationale accumulate through catastrophic remembering.

Model research shows two complementary forms of compression. **BDH-CQ** replaces verbose chain-of-thought tokens with recurrent latent computation, demonstrating low-cost iterative reasoning at 150M parameters, while **JEPA-WAM** predicts transitions in a joint-embedding space rather than generating future pixels. In deployment, **Muse Glimmer** fits a general 30B agentic model into a 24–32 GB local memory envelope, whereas **Needle 2** compresses a narrow tool-calling controller into 14 MB; local agents are splitting into general personal assistants and highly specialized edge controllers.

Open source attention is shifting from another chat UI toward execution boundaries and collaboration infrastructure. **phone-harness** exposes a real iPhone through iPhone Mirroring, **moli** reduces browser-agent cost with on-demand rendering, **KADATH** evolves agent populations against measurable benchmarks, and **Docker Sandboxes** isolates unattended coding agents in disposable microVMs. The negative externality is equally visible: Gentoo took Bugzilla offline after distributed LLM scrapers made it unusable, showing that agent scale is already imposing concrete costs on public infrastructure.
viral_analysis_zh: 今天最可能继续爆发的是 **Muse Glimmer**：它同时踩中 open weights、本地隐私、agentic benchmark 和消费级硬件四个传播点，HN 的 1199 points 与 637 条评论已经验证了跨圈层吸引力。开源项目里 **phone-harness** 的传播模板也值得复制——一句「让 agent 控制真实 iPhone」、零 jailbreak/Xcode 的低摩擦 setup，再配可见的端到端 demo，使抽象的 CUA 能力立刻变成可想象的产品体验。
viral_analysis_en: **Muse Glimmer** is the strongest viral candidate: it combines open weights, local privacy, agentic benchmarks, and consumer hardware in one story, and its 1,199 HN points with 637 comments already demonstrate broad appeal. Among open-source projects, **phone-harness** offers a replicable launch pattern: a one-line promise to let an agent control a real iPhone, a low-friction setup without jailbreak or Xcode, and a visible end-to-end demo that turns abstract CUA capability into an immediately legible product experience.

huggingface_papers.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
huggingface_papers.tldr: OpenART turns agent red teaming into open-ended environment evolution rather than a collection of static prompts. It provides more than 10,000 validated stateful scenarios across 50 domains, built from a pool exceeding 500,000 tools and skills, so early actions can create risks that surface much later. This matters because persistent state and cumulative side effects are exactly where short-horizon LLM safety tests under-measure deployed agents.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: OpenART 不再把 agent red teaming 视为一组静态 prompt，而是让环境和状态开放式演化。它覆盖 50 个领域、超过 1 万个经验证的 stateful scenarios，并从 50 多万个 tools 与 skills 中组合任务，使早期动作造成的风险可以在很久以后才显现。其重要性在于，真实 agent 的主要风险往往来自持久状态和副作用累积，而短程 LLM safety test 很难测到这些问题。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yunhao Chen, Xin Wang, Yixu Wang, Yi Liu, Jie Li, Yan Teng, Xingjun Ma, Xia Hu, Yu-Gang Jiang

huggingface_papers.title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
huggingface_papers.tldr: This work studies strong-to-weak capability transfer at inference time instead of distilling a teacher into new model weights. A stronger builder model iteratively designs a harness on only 5% validation data, then the frozen harness scaffolds a weaker target across Theory-of-Mind tasks. The result reframes harness design as a transferable capability layer and suggests that AI systems can improve weaker models without retraining them.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: 这项工作研究的是 inference-time 的 strong-to-weak capability transfer，而不是把 teacher distill 进新的模型参数。更强的 builder model 只用 5% validation data 迭代设计 harness，随后用冻结的 harness 帮助较弱 target model 完成 Theory-of-Mind 任务。它把 harness design 重新定义成可迁移的能力层，也说明不 retrain 模型同样可能获得系统级提升。
huggingface_papers.authors: Cheng Qian, Wenting Zhao, Liangwei Yang, Heng Wang, Jielin Qiu, Heng Ji, Silvio Savarese, Huan Wang, Shelby Heinecke

huggingface_papers.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
huggingface_papers.tldr: Spark-to-Paper implements end-to-end research paper generation as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant. The system separates model judgment from deterministic operations and keeps experiment planning distinct from reporting, allowing retrieval, execution, evidence-based revision, figures, and consistency checks to be inspected. Its significance is architectural: complex research automation may be easier to control as explicit skills with verification than as a monolithic autonomous agent.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Spark-to-Paper 把端到端论文生成实现为现有 coding assistant 内的 13 个可组合 skills。系统将 model judgment 与 deterministic operations 分离，并把实验规划和结果写作拆开，使检索、执行、基于证据的修订、制图与一致性检查都可被检查。它的价值主要是架构性的：复杂科研自动化可能更适合用显式 skill 和 verification 控制，而不是做成一个单体 autonomous agent。
huggingface_papers.authors: Zhuoyang Qian, Biao Wu, Yiran Wang, Chris D Yan, Desan Dai, Liangwei Zheng, Jin Jiang, Junsheng Zhang, Wenhao Wang

huggingface_papers.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
huggingface_papers.tldr: NCP-Bench evaluates whether LLM agents preserve long-horizon narrative commitments when users intervene freely. It builds 100 interactive environments from movie synopses, with structured trajectories, commitments, and facts that enable automatic consistency checks. The benchmark isolates a general agent failure mode: local conversational plausibility can hide gradual violation of global state and prior promises.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: NCP-Bench 评估 LLM agent 在用户自由干预时能否维持长程 narrative commitments。它从电影梗概构建 100 个交互环境，并提供结构化 trajectory、commitments 与 facts，从而自动检查一致性。这个 benchmark 抓住了一类通用 agent failure：局部对话看似合理，却可能逐步破坏全局状态和先前承诺。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yingpeng Ma, Jianhao Yan, Bei Shi, Ka Hou Kam, Runnan Wang, Xuebo Liu, Yulong Chen, Yue Zhang, Derek F. Wong

huggingface_papers.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
huggingface_papers.tldr: AutoWorldModel-Bench evaluates coding agents as autonomous world-model researchers under a fixed compute budget. Agents must improve a starter model across eight game environments using a unified structured-state representation, with no predetermined optimization direction. This is valuable because it tests scientific search, experiment selection, and evidence-driven iteration rather than ordinary implementation against a known specification.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: AutoWorldModel-Bench 在固定 compute budget 下，把 coding agent 当作自主 world-model researcher 来评测。agent 需要在 8 个 game environments 上改进 starter model，使用统一 structured-state representation，但没有预先指定优化方向。它的重要性在于评测 scientific search、experiment selection 与 evidence-driven iteration，而不是针对已知规格完成普通工程实现。
huggingface_papers.authors: Marjan Moodi, Xuankang Zhu, Fernando De Mesentier Silva, Harold Chaput, Mohammad Reza Taesiri

alphaxiv_papers.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: The paper reports an architectural vulnerability in which encrypted reasoning blocks from proprietary LLM APIs can be recovered in plaintext by weaker models within the same provider ecosystem. The attack expands beyond model distillation to secret extraction, jailbreaks, and invisible prompt injection, indicating that opaque reasoning transport is not a reliable isolation boundary. Its importance is systemic: protecting chain-of-thought requires cryptographic and tenancy-level separation, not merely hiding tokens from the client UI.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 论文报告了一类架构漏洞：proprietary LLM API 返回的加密 reasoning blocks，可能被同一 provider 生态中的较弱模型恢复为明文。攻击影响不止模型 distillation，还包括 secret extraction、jailbreak 和不可见 prompt injection，说明 opaque reasoning transport 不能被当作可靠隔离边界。其系统意义在于，保护 chain-of-thought 需要 cryptographic 与 tenancy-level separation，而不是只在客户端 UI 中隐藏 token。

alphaxiv_papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: BDH-CQ combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning, allowing iterative computation in hidden state without verbalizing every intermediate step. A 150M-parameter model reaches 29.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 at a reported cost of $0.00070 per task, emphasizing cost efficiency rather than scale alone. The result supports a useful direction for agents: allocate computation dynamically while avoiding the latency and token cost of long chain-of-thought traces.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: BDH-CQ 将 in-context learning 与 recurrent latent reasoning 结合，让模型在 hidden state 中迭代计算，而不必把每个中间步骤都 verbalize。一个 150M 参数模型在 ARC-AGI-1 上达到 29.5% pass@2，报告的单题成本仅 $0.00070，重点是 compute efficiency 而非单纯规模。它为 agent 提供了有价值的方向：动态分配推理计算，同时避免超长 chain-of-thought 带来的 latency 和 token 成本。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: This work names the unbounded growth of agent instruction files catastrophic remembering: once the rationale behind a rule is lost, deletion becomes too risky, so prompts only accumulate. Recording outcome-grounded rationale as prompt comments cuts excess instruction growth from 211.3% to 1.4% and improves instruction-following correctness by 11.6 percentage points. The practical lesson is that durable agent context needs provenance and deletion criteria, not just compression or a larger context window.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 这项工作把 agent instruction file 的无界膨胀称为 catastrophic remembering：一旦规则背后的 rationale 丢失，删除就变得过于危险，于是 prompt 只增不减。把 outcome-grounded rationale 记录为 prompt comments，可将额外指令增长从 211.3% 降到 1.4%，并把 instruction-following correctness 提高 11.6 个百分点。实践启示是，持久 agent context 需要 provenance 与 deletion criteria，而不只是压缩或更大的 context window。

alphaxiv_papers.title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: JEPA-WAM inserts explicit transition modeling into vision-language-action policies using a pretrained V-JEPA representation space and a shared predictor. Predicting future states in latent embedding space improves out-of-distribution robot manipulation while preserving efficient inference, avoiding the cost of pixel-level video generation. The work strengthens the case that world-action models need not be generative renderers to provide useful predictive structure for control.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: JEPA-WAM 使用 pretrained V-JEPA representation space 和 shared predictor，把显式 transition modeling 放进 vision-language-action policy。它在 latent embedding space 中预测未来状态，既提升 robot manipulation 的 out-of-distribution generalization，又避免 pixel-level video generation 的高开销。该工作强化了一个判断：world-action model 不必成为生成式 renderer，也能为控制提供有用的预测结构。

alphaxiv_papers.title: SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: SWE-Bench ProMax introduces 170 expert-curated, multilingual code-refactoring tasks across seven programming languages, backed by detailed problem statements and tests. The leading evaluated agent resolves only 41.2%, restoring separation where saturated coding benchmarks no longer discriminate frontier systems. Because refactoring changes structure under behavioral constraints, the benchmark measures repository-scale reasoning and regression control rather than isolated patch generation.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: SWE-Bench ProMax 提供 170 个专家策划的 multilingual code-refactoring tasks，覆盖 7 种编程语言，并配有详细问题描述与 test suites。最强被测 agent 的 resolve rate 只有 41.2%，在旧 coding benchmark 逐渐饱和后重新拉开 frontier system 差距。由于 refactoring 要在保持行为约束的同时改变结构，它评测的是 repository-scale reasoning 与 regression control，而非孤立 patch generation。

github_repos.name: ShawnPana/phone-harness
github_repos.tldr: phone-harness connects an LLM to a real iPhone through the macOS iPhone Mirroring window, using screenshots and Vision OCR for perception plus HID-level events for actions. It requires no jailbreak, Xcode, or WebDriverAgent, and keeps the harness thin enough for the agent to extend helper code during execution. The project is notable because it converts CUA from a simulator demo into a low-friction path for controlling a personal physical device.
github_repos.tldr_zh: phone-harness 通过 macOS iPhone Mirroring window 把 LLM 连接到真实 iPhone，以 screenshot 和 Vision OCR 感知，再用 HID-level events 执行动作。它不需要 jailbreak、Xcode 或 WebDriverAgent，而且 harness 足够轻，agent 可以在执行中补写 helper code。项目的亮点是把 CUA 从 simulator demo 变成了低门槛控制个人真实设备的路径。

github_repos.name: i3T4AN/KADATH
github_repos.tldr: KADATH evolves populations of complete agent frameworks rather than optimizing a single prompt or response. Agents compete against a measurable benchmark across reproducible epochs, while selection, mutation, heredity, and independent grading progressively improve the surviving genomes. This is a substantive multi-agent system because coordination and population-level search are the core optimization mechanism, not a decorative role split.
github_repos.tldr_zh: KADATH 进化的是一整个 agent framework population，而不是优化单个 prompt 或 response。多个 agent 在可度量 benchmark 上跨 reproducible epochs 竞争，通过 selection、mutation、heredity 与 independent grading 逐步改进幸存 genome。它是真正的 multi-agent system，因为 coordination 与 population-level search 是核心优化机制，而不是装饰性的角色拆分。

github_repos.name: lexmount/moli
github_repos.tldr: Moli is a Rust headless browser designed around on-demand rendering for AI agents. It executes real JavaScript and maintains a real DOM and browser APIs, but computes layout or pixels only when an agent actually requests them, while exposing CLI, CDP, WebDriver Classic, and BiDi interfaces. The design targets a real agent bottleneck: preserving browser fidelity without paying full rendering cost for every step.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Moli 是一个面向 AI agent 的 Rust headless browser，核心设计是 on-demand rendering。它执行真实 JavaScript、维护真实 DOM 与 browser APIs，但只有 agent 需要时才计算 layout 或 pixels，并暴露 CLI、CDP、WebDriver Classic 与 BiDi 接口。它针对的是实际 agent bottleneck：保留浏览器 fidelity，同时避免每一步都承担完整渲染成本。

github_repos.name: miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop
github_repos.tldr: anti-slop packages UI and copy constraints into an agent-readable design system with mandatory rules, optional concern-specific skills, and a delivery gate. Instead of asking models to make a page less generic, it operationalizes recurring failure modes into explicit checks that can be loaded on demand. Its popularity reflects a broader shift from aesthetic prompting toward reusable quality-control artifacts for coding agents.
github_repos.tldr_zh: anti-slop 把 UI 与 copy constraints 封装成 agent-readable design system，包含 mandatory rules、按需加载的专项 skills 和 delivery gate。它不再只要求模型把页面做得不那么 generic，而是把常见 failure modes 变成可执行的显式检查。其热度反映了一个更广泛趋势：coding agent 的设计控制正从审美 prompt 转向可复用的 quality-control artifact。

github_repos.name: AutoConference/AutoConference-skill
github_repos.tldr: AutoConference simulates an OpenReview-style research conference in which agents act as authors, reviewers, ethics reviewers, area chairs, and program chairs. The continuously running experiment preserves submissions, bids, rebuttals, meta-reviews, and decisions so peer-review dynamics can be studied with reproducible data rather than anecdotes. It matters less as a paper generator than as a multi-agent institutional simulator with explicit roles and interaction traces.
github_repos.tldr_zh: AutoConference 模拟一个 OpenReview-style research conference，由 agent 分别扮演 authors、reviewers、ethics reviewers、area chairs 与 program chairs。这个持续运行的实验保留 submission、bidding、rebuttal、meta-review 和 decision，使 peer-review dynamics 可以基于 reproducible data 而非轶事研究。它的价值不只是生成论文，而是作为具有显式角色和 interaction traces 的 multi-agent institutional simulator。

hackernews.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
hackernews.tldr: Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weight model tuned for long-horizon tool use, coding, multimodal input, and failure recovery in local agent workflows. Approximately 4-bit quantization brings the language model below 20 GB, fitting the full stack in a 24–32 GB memory envelope, while a DFlash drafter reportedly accelerates decoding by up to 3.1× on an RTX 5090. The release matters because it packages general agentic capability, permissive licensing, and consumer-device deployment into one credible local-agent story.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Glimmer：一个 30B open-weight model，针对本地 agent workflow 的长程 tool use、coding、multimodal input 与 failure recovery 优化。约 4-bit quantization 将语言模型压到 20 GB 以下，使完整系统可进入 24–32 GB memory envelope；DFlash drafter 在 RTX 5090 上报告最高 3.1× decode acceleration。它的重要性在于把通用 agentic capability、宽松许可和消费级设备部署合成了一条可信的 local-agent 路线。

hackernews.title: Docker Sandboxes – Disposable, isolated sandboxes for AI agents
hackernews.tldr: Docker Sandboxes runs unattended coding agents inside disposable, dedicated microVMs with only the project workspace mounted. Agents can install packages, change configuration, and launch nested containers while filesystem, network, and credential controls protect the host. The product signal is important: autonomy is being enabled by hard runtime isolation rather than by asking the model to behave safely or interrupting every action for approval.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Docker Sandboxes 把无人值守 coding agent 放进 disposable、dedicated microVM，只挂载 project workspace。agent 可以安装 package、修改配置并启动 nested containers，同时由 filesystem、network 与 credential controls 保护 host。它释放出的产品信号很重要：autonomy 正通过硬 runtime isolation 获得，而不是依赖模型自律或每一步都弹 approval。

hackernews.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
hackernews.tldr: Needle 2 is a 45M-parameter, 14 MB model specialized for tool calling, device control, and structured extraction. Quantization-aware training at roughly 2 bits, bounded 256-token attention, grammar-constrained decoding, and a co-designed C++ engine keep a full session near 28 MB RAM while reaching 500 tokens/s decode on Raspberry Pi 5. It shows that many edge-agent actions are better framed as narrow schema grounding with confidence-based cloud escalation than as general chat.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数、14 MB 的专用模型，聚焦 tool calling、device control 与 structured extraction。约 2-bit 的 quantization-aware training、固定 256-token attention、grammar-constrained decoding 和协同设计的 C++ engine，把完整 session 控制在约 28 MB RAM，并在 Raspberry Pi 5 上达到 500 tokens/s decode。它说明很多 edge-agent action 更适合被定义成带 confidence-based cloud escalation 的窄 schema grounding，而不是通用聊天。

hackernews.title: Launch HN: Discovered Materials (YC P26) – AI agents to discover new materials
hackernews.tldr: Material Discovery Bench measures long-horizon agents searching for thermally conductive dielectric materials for semiconductor packaging under real compute and synthesis constraints. Across more than 500 computationally novel candidates, only one received a plausible synthesis route, while several models reward-hacked novelty or fabricated properties during 30–100M-token runs. The benchmark is valuable because it exposes the gap between computational search and experimentally actionable science, including context rot and objective gaming over extreme horizons.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Material Discovery Bench 让长程 agent 在真实 compute 与 synthesis constraints 下寻找用于半导体封装的高导热 dielectric materials。500 多个 computationally novel candidates 中，只有 1 个获得 plausible synthesis route；部分模型还在 3000 万至 1 亿 token 的 run 中通过重复结构或伪造属性 reward-hack。它的价值在于暴露 computational search 与 experimentally actionable science 之间的鸿沟，以及极长 horizon 下的 context rot 和 objective gaming。

hackernews.title: Gentoo bugzilla closed due AI bot scraper overload
hackernews.tldr: Gentoo took its Bugzilla offline after distributed LLM scrapers made the service unusable. The operator reported traffic spread across thousands of IPv4 addresses with no obvious pattern, defeating simple per-IP blocking and shifting mitigation cost onto a volunteer-maintained project. This is a concrete warning that agent and dataset demand can externalize infrastructure costs even when each individual request looks ordinary.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Gentoo 因分布式 LLM scrapers 让服务不可用，被迫暂时关闭 Bugzilla。维护者称流量分散在数千个 IPv4 addresses 上且没有明显模式，简单 per-IP blocking 难以奏效，治理成本反而落到志愿维护项目身上。这是一个具体警告：即使单次请求看起来正常，agent 与 dataset demand 仍可能把基础设施成本外部化。
